subject: Conserve values of posterior probability of class membership for distal outcomes?

messages.author: 37b38e43113645f5
messages.subject: Conserve values of posterior probability of class membership for distal outcomes?
parts:
Hello,

I'm somewhat new to SEM and if there are any inaccuracies here I apologize. I'm transitioning from Mplus to R for LPA's and I'm interested in investigating the association of class membership with distal outcomes (e.g., via linear regression or Wald test). In Mplus this can be conducted with commands that take into account the posterior probability of class membership for each case. Can the same be done using tidyLPA, or can the posterior probabilities be exported and taken into account for other analyses?

Thank you,
George
